paragraphs: Our class has a party on Friday. It is a dress up party. Lily wants to be a lion. May wants to be a panda. Leo says, "I want to be both!" Teacher Kim says, "Let's make masks!" "What do we need?" asks May. "You need paper, a pencil, and scissors," says Teacher Kim. She writes the steps on the board.

First, draw a big circle on the paper. A circle is a round shape. Second, cut out the circle. Third, draw two eyes on the circle. Then cut out the eyes. Draw a nose and a mouth too. For a lion, draw long hair around the circle. For a panda, make the eyes black. Last, hold the mask in front of your face. Be careful with the scissors.

The children make their masks. Lily has a yellow lion mask. May has a black and white panda mask. Leo has a lion mask and a panda mask. "I am a lion-panda!" says Leo. Everyone laughs. On Friday, the children put on their masks. "Grr!" says Lily. "I am a lion!" Now you can try. What mask do you want?
